title: 【うんちく】地球を半径1kmにしたら、歩くだけで人工衛星 #Shorts
description:
地球を、同じ材料（同じ密度）のまま半径1kmに縮めたら、重力は6400分の1。地面すれすれを回る速さは秒速1.24mで、ふつうに歩くより少しおそいくらい。ジャンプして秒速1.76mをこえると、二度と戻れません。

アプリ「ちいさな地球」（地球を同じ密度のまま小さくした星）に関係する話です。

アプリ: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/tiny-earth/

しし屋 まなびラボ（ほかのアプリ）: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

出どころ: NASA Earth Fact Sheet・Bohannon (1997) Age and Ageing（歩く速さ）。空気・山・でこぼこのない、理想の計算です。

声: VOICEVOX:冥鳴ひまり
BGM: "Sneaky Snitch" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)

en.title: Did you know? Shrink Earth to a 1 km radius and walking puts you in orbit #Shorts
en.description:
Shrink Earth to a 1 km radius, made of the same stuff, and gravity drops to 1/6400. Orbiting at ground level takes 1.24 m/s, slightly slower than walking. Jump faster than 1.76 m/s and you never come back. Turn on English subtitles (CC).

Related to the app "A Tiny Earth" (Earth shrunk at the same density).

App (switch to English with the EN button): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/tiny-earth/

Shishiya Manabi Lab (more apps): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/?lang=en

Sources: NASA Earth Fact Sheet; Bohannon (1997) Age and Ageing (walking speed). An idealized calculation with no air, mountains or bumps.

Voice: VOICEVOX:Meimei Himari
Music: "Sneaky Snitch" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
